transcript.content: Cluster 423's top up-regulated markers are: pmela, tyrp1b, dct, sfrp2, fmoda, slc45a2, tspan36, pmp22a. Using ZFIN curated expression, ZFA anatomy, and GO, identify the most likely zebrafish cell type (with state if the markers support it), grounding each claim in a cited record. If the evidence is ambiguous, say so.

**Melanocyte / melanophore, mature pigment-producing state.**

## Evidence
- **pmela** — premelanosome protein; acts in melanocyte differentiation and melanosome organization, expressed in pigment cell [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-9818).  
- **tyrp1b** — tyrosinase-related enzyme; predicted melanosome activity, expressed in melanoblast and pigment cell [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040718-249).  
- **dct** — curated figure labels dct-positive melanoblasts and melanocytes; caption states dct marks melanoblasts during/after migration and labels all melanophores at 48 hpf [record](https://www.zfin.org/ZDB-FIG-060912-3).  
- **slc45a2** — pigmentation/albinism gene; acts in melanocyte differentiation, expressed in melanoblast and pigment cell as well as RPE/retina [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050208-97).  
- **melanocyte / melanophore** — ZFA term defines this as a neural-crest-derived pigment cell with melanin-filled granules, appearing brown-to-black [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0009091).  
- **GO:0032438** — melanosome organization covers assembly/arrangement of the melanin-synthesizing/storing organelle, matching pmela/tyrp1b/dct/slc45a2 biology [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0032438).  

## Caveats
- slc45a2/tyrp1b can also involve retinal pigment epithelium, but the combined pmela–dct–tyrp1b–slc45a2 signature is strongest for melanophore lineage.

**Verdict:** melanocyte/melanophore, mature — confidence high

Independent second read (alternative-hypothesis pass) for the same cluster:

**Most defensible: melanocyte/melanophore, mature pigment cell; alternative RPE/pigmented epithelium remains plausible but less specific.**

## Evidence
- **pmela** — curated expression includes pigment cell; ZFA pigment cell lists pmela among genes with figures, supporting chromatophore identity [record](https://zfin.org/action/marker/ZDB-GENE-030131-9818/expression), [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0009090).
- **tyrp1b** — expressed in melanoblast and pigment cell; functions upstream of melanosome organization and RPE development, so it supports melanocyte but also leaves an RPE alternative [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040718-249).
- **dct** — expressed in integument, neural crest, and eye; acts in melanin metabolic process, matching GO “melanin metabolic process” [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-000508-1), [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0006582).
- **slc45a2** — perturbation decreases melanocyte amount, and SLC45A2 knockout shows albino phenotype rescued by melanocyte-specific expression, strongly favoring melanocyte pigmentation machinery [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-MRPHLNO-121203-4), [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-PUB-260219-8).
- **Alternative: RPE** — ZFA defines retinal pigmented epithelium as pigmented epithelium covering neural retina; tyrp1b/dct eye/RPE links make this possible, but the marker set is not eye- or epithelial-specific [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0000144), [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040718-249).
- **Alternative: melanoleucophore/adult fin pigment derivative** — ZFA melanoleucophore explicitly expresses tyrp1b, but lacks support from the rest of this marker panel, so it is weaker [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0005928).

## Caveats
- Deepest defensible tier is **cell type: melanocyte/melanophore**; RPE cannot be excluded without atlas location or epithelial/RPE markers.
- sfrp2/fmoda/pmp22a may reflect local mesenchymal/neural-crest context, not a different identity.

**Verdict:** melanocyte/melanophore, mature — confidence high

The two literature reads and the raw data agree strongly: Cluster 423 is a melanophore/melanocyte cluster, not a generic neural-crest, mesenchymal, or RPE-only population.

The decisive markers are all both biologically coherent and Archivist-confirmed as enriched here:

- **pmela** is the strongest DEG by log2FC among the pigment markers, with log2FC 3.384, 62.5% in-cluster versus 2.9% out, and strong cross-cluster specificity. Its premelanosome biology supports a melanin-producing melanophore identity.
- **tyrp1b** is similarly strong, log2FC 3.214, 55.0% versus 3.2%, supporting melanogenesis/pigment-cell identity.
- **dct** is slightly lower by log2FC but the most specific of the core melanophore genes reported, rank 7/470, with log2FC 3.163 and 52.5% versus 2.3%.
- **slc45a2** is less highly expressed but still clearly enriched, log2FC 2.376, 47.5% versus 1.8%, reinforcing pigment-cell differentiation rather than contradicting it.

The alternative RPE hypothesis is weaker because no RPE-specific epithelial/retinal marker is needed to explain the cluster, while the core enriched panel is a canonical melanophore/melanocyte program. **sfrp2** and **fmoda** are enriched but broader and likely contextual, not identity-defining. The call is settled; further queries are unlikely to change the identity.
